item.name: Two-handed Sword of Nirmek

ownerLore.text: Nirmek was a cursed dwarven shepherd who lived between 359 - ???.

item.description: Nirmek was a cursed dwarven shepherd who lived between 359 - ???. The two-handed sword bears a single dark stain that no amount of cleaning has managed to remove. Rare among things pulled from the dark, this one seems to mean you well.

item.name: Leather Armor of Uvel

ownerLore.text: Uvel was a cursed dwarven cult leader who lived between 489 - 558.

item.description: Uvel was a cursed dwarven cult leader who lived between 489 - 558. The leather armor is covered in tiny scratches, as though someone spent years trying to write something into it. It seems to settle, almost gratefully, into the hands of someone willing to stand and hold a line.

item.name: The Adze of Bofur

ownerLore.text: Bofur was a disreputable dwarven chancellor who lived between 160 - 266.

item.description: Bofur was a disreputable dwarven chancellor who lived between 160 - 266. Strange markings cover the adze, in a script no scholar of this age can read. Legend credits The Adze of Bofur with both its making and its ruin, though no two tellings agree which came first.

item.name: Leather Armor of Dornir

ownerLore.text: Dornir was a disreputable dwarven butler who lived between 380 - ???.

item.description: Dornir was a disreputable dwarven butler who lived between 380 - ???. An ancient leather armor, its surface worn smooth by centuries of unknown hands. It was carried by those sworn to protect something greater than themselves.

items.name: Potion of Speed
items.description: A fleeting burst of movement speed lasting 15 turns. A fresh dose refreshes the effect.

groundItems.description: An old iron stove stands against the tower wall.

merchantStock.name: Blighted Spiked Shield
merchantStock.description: This spiked shield hums faintly when held, as though something inside it is still awake. Legend credits Blighted Spiked Shield with both its making and its ruin, though no two tellings agree which came first. Those who carried it before you did not carry it for long.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Identification
merchantStock.description: Reveals the true name, effects and possible curse of one unidentified artifact.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Homecoming
merchantStock.description: A magical passage back to the Temple, far from the dangers of the wilderness.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Invisibility
merchantStock.description: A scroll that conceals you from ordinary sight for a limited time. True-sighted enemies may still detect you.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Fireball
merchantStock.description: Aim within 6 visible tiles. A 5×5 blast without corners deals 10–50 damage per creature, including you, ignoring armor. Walls block fire. Preview then Cast; Cancel costs nothing.

merchantStock.name: Flint Stone
merchantStock.description: Reusable fire-lighting tool. Use an abandoned campfire to light it with brushwood.

merchantStock.name: Brushwood
merchantStock.description: Dry fuel for an abandoned campfire. One bundle burns for 12 turns. Carry up to five.

merchantStock.name: Arrows
merchantStock.description: Ammunition for bows. Each shot consumes one arrow.
